en-US.longDescription:
Embark together on your fantasy adventure!
 Set hundreds of years in the future on the distant planet of Aida, the shared open-world MMORPG, anime-infused sci-fi adventure Tower of Fantasy from developer Hotta Studio and publisher Level Infinite, is now available on PC and mobile platforms globally.
 Players will be able to experience an anime-inspired post-apocalyptic sci-fi art style, freeform character development, and exciting combat through thrilling battles and exciting open-world exploration.
en-US.name: Tower of Fantasy

zh-CN.description: 共享开放世界大型多人在线角色扮演游戏
zh-CN.longDescription: 一起踏上您的奇幻冒险！由开发商 Hotta Studio 和发行商 Level Infinite 开发的共享开放世界大型多人在线角色扮演游戏、动漫科幻冒险塔楼以遥远的艾达星球上的未来数百年为背景，现在可在全球 PC 和移动平台上使用。玩家将能够通过激动人心的战斗和激动人心的开放世界探索，体验受动漫启发的后世界末日科幻艺术风格、自由形式的角色发展和激动人心的战斗。
zh-CN.name: Tower of Fantasy
